'''Dyplotids''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]], possessing four [[eye]]s that allowed them to see both the [[ultraviolet]] and [[infrared]] spectrum. Members of the species had been present at locations such as [[the Lodge]] on [[Vandor]] and the ''[[First Light]]''. [[Craykan]] was a member of this species who served as one of the three [[Tech Masters]] that ruled the [[planet]] [[Trionak]], while [[Limal Pakt]] was a Dyplotid [[metalsmith]] who operated a [[Limal Pakt's shop|shop]] in the [[Federal District]] on [[Coruscant]].

==Biology and appearance==
Dyplotids were a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that were commonly [[Color|brown]], pink, or purple in coloration, possessing two legs, as well as two [[limb|arms]] that ended in five-fingered hands. Dyplotids had large craniums, with flat faces that displayed no visible [[nose]]. These faces did, however, feature four keen [[eye]]s which granted them the ability to observe both the [[infrared]] and [[ultraviolet]] ends of the color spectrum. The species could grow black or brown [[hair]] on the sides, top, and back of their heads, as well as facial hair such as beards.<ref name="The Official Guide" />

==History==
Dyplotids were known present within the wider galaxy by [[232 BBY]].<ref name="YJADate">{{YJADate|202A}}</ref>

==Dyplotids in the galaxy==
[[File:Brooks-YJA-RustlerRoundup.png|thumb|left|200px|Dyplotid Brooks was a mayor of a Nerf herding town.]]
During the [[High Republic Era]], the Dyplotid [[Brooks]] served as mayor of a [[Nerf herder|nerf herding]] town on a [[Unidentified astronomical object (Brooks)|rocky world]]. Brooks had befriended [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Bell Zettifar]], who returned to the town with Initiate [[Kai Brightstar]] on a mission to help the locals. When they arrived, Brooks was rallying citizens to confront [[nerf]] rustlers who had stolen the herd, but he agreed to give the Jedi a chance to resolve the incident peacefully first. The Jedi succeeded in freeing the herd, though the rustlers would intercept them on the way back to town. A confrontation followed, leading to the rustlers revealing that they were descendants of former townsfolk who had been denied their share of the nerf herd. Brooks eventually settled the dispute by giving them the herd, restoring peace among the locals.<ref name="The Rustler Roundup">{{YJA|The Rustler Roundup}}</ref>

In [[231 BBY]],<ref name="TOS1Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 1 to [[231 BBY]].</ref> a Dyplotid served with the [[Republic Defense Coalition troop|Republic Defense Coalition troops]] and was present for a shootout on [[Vrant Tarnum]] between the [[Republic Defense Coalition|Defense Coalition]] and [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|Pirates]]. The [[Trooper|troopers]] accompanied the [[Jedi investigator]] [[Emerick Caphtor]] on his [[Debacle on Vrant Tarnum|mission]] to the [[Kharvashark Ruins]] while he was investigating the death of [[Loden Greatstorm]].<ref name="TOS 1">[[The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 1|''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 1]]</ref> The Dyplotid [[Limal Pakt]] was a highly recommended and qualified [[metalsmith]] who operated a shop in the [[Federal District]] of [[Republic City]]. [[Jedi Master]] [[Elzar Mann]] visited Pakt's shop to acquire a new [[Avar Kriss' second diadem|diadem]] for Master [[Avar Kriss]]. Pakt wrapped the delicate object, which featured a triplet of small star gems fitted into the central arcing arrowtip, in silk after receiving final payment, for which Elzar thanked her for her astonishing work.<ref name="Temptation of the Force">''[[The High Republic: Temptation of the Force]]''</ref>

[[File:FadderaRabar.png|thumb|right|200px|Faddera Rabar, a member of Enfys Nest's Cloud-Riders]]
in [[26 BBY]],<ref name="AOR Dooku Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Age of Republic - Count Dooku'' 1 to [[26 BBY]].</ref> [[Count]] [[Dooku]] of [[Serenno]] visited the planet [[Sullust]] on a [[Mission on Sullust|assignment]] where he would meet and eat with both the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Jak'zin]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation]] representative [[Kap Klyp]], having shared a dining hall with a Dyplotid patron.<ref name="AoR Dooku">[[Age of Republic - Count Dooku 1|''Age of Republic - Count Dooku'' 1]]</ref> Sometime prior to [[10 BBY]]<ref name="Date Note">The timeline provided in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' places the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' nine [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of that film in [[19 BBY]], we can deduce that the events of the film took place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> the Dyplotid [[Faddera Rabar]]<ref name="Card Trader">{{SWCT|set=The Cloud-Riders|cardname=Faddera Rabar}}</ref> served as a member of [[Enfys Nest]]'s [[Cloud-Riders]], the result of being native to a world that had been devastated by one of the [[Five Crime Syndicates]]. Rabar was present for the factions [[Heist on Vandor]] which went awry, and on [[Savareen]], Rabar would stand alongside eleven other members of the Cloud-Riders as they confronted the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon]], before bringing them inside a [[cantina]] for a drink.<ref name="Solo" />

The Dylplotid [[Tarubo Bunzo]] was a [[Astantu Distillery]] sale representative who hailed from the [[Ring of Kafrene]], having hoped to land a business deal with the [[Crime lord|crime boss]] [[Dryden Vos]].<ref name="The Official Guide" /> Bunzo was present aboard Dryden's ship ''[[First Light]]'' when [[Han Solo]] and his companions were introduced to Voss by his servant [[Qi'ra|Qi’ra]] after failing to deliver on the Heist on Vandor.<ref name="Solo" /> Shortly before the [[Raid on Kessel]], multiple Dylpotids were present within [[the Lodge]] at [[Fort Ypso]] when high ranking [[Crimson Dawn]] operative Qi'ra brought Han Solo, [[Chewbacca]], and [[Tobias Beckett]] there tomeet [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], a skilled [[gambler]], [[smuggler]], and [[pilot]] who had won his ship in a game of [[sabacc]].<ref name="Solo" />

Sometime between [[0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY]],<ref name="CYDLLDate">''Choose Your Destiny: A Luke & Leia Adventure'' takes place between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, dated to [[0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref>, Lord [[Craykan]], a male Dyplotid, operated as one of the three [[Tech Masters]] who governed the junk planet [[Trionak]]. He sat on a large hovering throne in a grand chamber at the top of the [[Tech Masters' citadel]], flanked by the [[Keredian]] Lord [[Ruk]] to the right and a bulky [[Elnacon]], Lady [[Yarla]], to the left.<ref name="Choose Your Destiny Luke Leia">''[[Choose Your Destiny: A Luke & Leia Adventure]]''</ref> An unfortunate Dyplotid served as one of [[Rothwell]]’s goons in the [[Grand Arena]] on the planet [[Vespaara]]. He was tossed into the stands of the arena by [[Twi'lek]] [[Hunter (Grand Arena)|Hunter]] [[Tuya]] while cheering.<ref name="BftA">''[[Hunters: Battle for the Arena]]''</ref>

In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|1}}</ref> a Dyplotid was present within a [[Boatman's Reach|public house]] on the icy planet<ref name="Chapter 1" /> [[Pagodon]]<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Handbook]]''</ref> when [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]], utilizing a [[tracking fob]], arrived, seeking a [[Mythrol]][[The Fledgling Mythrol|fugitive]].<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}</ref> Shortly thereafter, another Dyplotid was present within a [[Nevarro school|bar]] on [[Nevarro]], seated behind Din and [[Greef Karga]] while they discussed bounties.<ref name="Chapter 3">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}}</ref>

[[File:Journal-Deek-TFGE.png|thumb|left|200px|The Dyplotid treasure hunter Deek.]]
In 34 ABY,<ref name="GEDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] to [[34 ABY]].</ref>, the Jedi artifact known as the [[Mural of the Light]] was uncovered by the Dyplotid [[Deek]]. At one point he planned to become partners with [[Ithorian]] antique dealer [[Dok-Ondar]], though a falling out would turn them into rivals. Deek travelled to an archaeological site in the ruins of [[Sardeevem Chasm]] where he believed the mural held significant historical value, though Dok knew it was actually a key to the treasure vaults of the lost Jedi Temple. As Deek feared the danger surrounding the discovery, multiple groups converged on the Chasm. Baron [[Yasto Attsmun]] of [[Listehol]], a band of pirates following in his wake, and an independent hunter, [[Lens Kamo]], all raced to obtain the cipher and reach the vault. Their search revealed that Deek had already been killed after hiding the relic to keep it from falling onto the black market.<ref name="Tales">''[[Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge – Last Call]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dyplotids first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', directed by [[Ron Howard]]. While not initially named onscreen,<ref name="Solo" /> they were eventually identified in the ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' visual guide.<ref name="The Official Guide" /> For ''Solo'', the mask used to represent the species was sculpted by [[Darren Nevin]].<ref name="DarrenInsta">{{Instagram|username=jahsonlion|url=p/B5PlHd4DxF4|name=[[Darren Nevin]]|date=2019-11-24|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/70vTQ}}</ref>
